projects.name: Deployment(B2B)
details: - Led the creation of user-friendly interfaces using React and Java, improving user engagement
by 20% with strong concepts of HTML and CSS.
- Integrated APIs for optimized data communication, enhancing data transfer times by 15%.
- Managed data with MongoDB and MySQL using stored procedures, achieving 30% faster data
retrieval.
- Hands-On experience in state management of components with Redux and React Context    API
and utilization of frameworks like Tailwind CSS and Ant Design in projects.
- Enhanced UX with web-hooks for instant notifications, increasing user engagement by 40%.
- Skilled in developing RESTful APIs and server-side logic using SpringBoot and Microservices.
- Utilized Kafka for high throughput,real time data feeds from different IoT systems to the
backend.
-Integrated with the CI/CD pipeline to ensure frequent, automated testing and delivery of new
features.
